coded_answer.p: The building called in French "Le Centre Pompidou" is a very surprising monument.

It's a modern building with an architecture that you can't see in
other place.

What is impressive
on
this building is the number of tubes that you can see outside and inside the building.

On
the
Pompidou's
center
, there are different
expositions
on different themes. In general, there are paintings, videos and sculptures.
This
expositions
are often very attractive and they change every year.

Another good point, if you go there you will have an extraordinary view
on
the city.

So if you visit Paris, the
Pompidou's
center
is a very interesting building to visit, even if in Paris there are many
others
buildings.
